resources.string: RykerConnect connects to your display over Bluetooth. To do this, the app needs permission to find and connect to Bluetooth devices.

Location permission supports device discovery and ride recording. Automatic trips need precise location; starting while the phone is locked also needs Allow all the time. Recorded routes stay on your phone unless you export them.
The app needs access to phone status to show your network connection (4G/5G) and signal strength on your helmet display.
RykerConnect needs notification permission to run reliably in the background and keep you informed about the connection status.

Check Bluetooth and notification permissions. For automatic trips when the Ryker connects while your phone is locked, choose Permissions, Location, Allow all the time, and enable precise location. Recording keeps a visible notification.
Enable notification access to show notifications from other apps, such as WhatsApp and incoming calls, on your helmet display.
